description: A 40x40 overflow: hidden frame with a fully rounded (circular) border-radius containing a 60x60 child -- the child must be clipped to the frame's rounded padding box, not just its rectangle.

florui.css: .frame { width: 40px; height: 40px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; } .content { width: 60px; height: 60px; background-color: #ff0000; }

classification.reason: The circular clip edge is anti-aliased by two different rasterizers. Measured against desktop Chrome: 4.22% of pixels differ (mean_error 0.726, max_error 38), geometry an exact 40x40 match -- the child is clipped to the same circle, only its edge coverage differs. Not re-measured against a software-rendered CI Chromium.
